description:
Bill of Materials (BOM) for CloudForge — import as type pom / scope import.
    Reactor modules: cloudforge-core, cloudforge-api. cloudforge-ministack and
    cloudforge-localstack are managed BOM coordinates but not reactor modules — each lives in its
    own repo (CloudForgeCI/cloudforge-ministack, CloudForgeCI/cloudforge-localstack), declares
    this pom as its Maven parent, and publishes independently on its own schedule; cloudforge-api's
    dependency on each pins an explicit real release (see 3.2.17/
    3.2.17), not this pom's own in-progress version.
    cloudforge-manager-deployment and cloudforge-manager are also not part of this
    BOM/reactor — split into their own private repos
    (CloudForgeCI/cloudforge-manager-deployment, CloudForgeCI/cloudforge-manager), each with a
    standalone pom.xml and independent versioning.
    See docs/architecture/cloudforge-sample-bom.template.md and
    docs/architecture/module-boundaries-and-refactor.plan.md.
